Natural Stone Specimen and Carving Collection
Banded Onyx, Agate, and Polished Jasper
Lot of 5 Pieces, up to 7" Long
Unsigned
This eclectic five-piece collection features a variety of natural stone specimens and artisanal carvings. The centerpiece is a hand-carved triceratops figurine rendered in banded onyx or calcite, showcasing rich concentric layers of amber, cream, and rust tones. Accompanying the carving are three natural agate geode halves, each featuring polished faces that reveal unique crystalline druzy centers and varying mineral hues of grey, lavender, and soft pink. The set is completed by a geometric stone pyramid with a distinctive black-spotted pattern, likely dalmatian jasper, providing a sharp contrast to the organic forms of the other pieces.
Hand-carved triceratops dinosaur figurine with natural mineral banding and a polished finish
Three natural agate specimens showing varying crystal formations and polished exterior rings
Polished stone pyramid featuring a monochromatic spotted aesthetic typical of dalmatian jasper
Largest piece measures approximately 7 inches in length
Condition:
Good overall vintage condition. The carved triceratops exhibits a notable chip to the top of its frill/horn section as shown in detailed close-up photos. The agate specimens and pyramid remain in stable condition with minor natural surface pitting and light shelf wear consistent with age and material.
